title: Representatives of restricted cohomology classes from a supplied filtered colimit
statement: Let X and X₀ be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], i:X₀→X a morphism [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], Λ a finite commutative ring, and A a small filtered category (nonempty, with common successors for two objects and eventual equalizers for parallel arrows). Let D:A→Mod(X_et,Λ) be a diagram of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], F a module sheaf, and ι:D→const(F) a cocone which is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every q≥0 and every c∈H^q(X₀,i⁻¹F) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there exist a∈A and z∈H^q(X₀,i⁻¹D(a)) such that H^q(i⁻¹ι_a)(z)=c. Cohomology and its maps are taken on underlying abelian sheaves. There is no constructibility hypothesis on D.

proof.text: Forget modules in the supplied colimit cocone; the forgetful functor preserves colimits.

Apply abelian inverse image, which preserves colimits. The natural compatibility with module inverse image identifies the resulting cocone, including each leg, with the underlying abelian restrictions of ι_a.

On the qcqs scheme X₀ the canonical filtered-colimit cohomology comparison makes H^q of that cocone a colimit cocone of abelian groups. Its legs are exactly H^q of the restricted ι_a. This is a mathematical application of Tag 03Q5; the current Lean declaration needs a u+1-sized indexing version and the natural comparison to Sheaf.H.

Every element of a filtered colimit of abelian groups has a representative at one stage. Concretely, forgetting to sets preserves this filtered colimit, and CategoryTheory.Limits.Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Limits/ConcreteCategory/Basic.lean:130) gives a and z. The leg identified in the previous step gives the required equality.

theorem exists_restriction_class_of_filtered_presentation
    {X X₀ : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X₀] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀] (i : X₀ ⟶ X)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    {F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)))
    (q : ℕ)
    (c : Sheaf.H ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)) q) :
    ∃ (a : A) (z : Sheaf.H ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj (D.obj a))) q),
      Sheaf.H.map ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].map (ι.app a))) q z = c
